scripts.build:integration: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=512' tsc && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=768' vite build && echo '✅ Bouquet built for Go integration at /bouquet/'
scripts.build:low-memory: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=384' tsc && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=512' vite build --mode production && echo '✅ Low-memory build completed'
scripts.build:ultra-low: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=256' tsc && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=320' vite build --config vite.config.ultra-low.ts --mode production && echo '✅ Ultra-low memory build completed'
scripts.build:minimal: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=192' tsc && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=256' vite build --config vite.config.ultra-low.ts --mode production && echo '✅ Minimal memory build completed'
scripts.build:no-typecheck: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=384' vite build --config vite.config.ultra-low.ts --mode production && echo '✅ Build completed (no type checking)'
scripts.build:extreme: NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=128' tsc --noEmit && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=192' vite build --config vite.config.ultra-low.ts --mode production && echo '✅ Extreme low-memory build completed'
